extraction.name: MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Video Understanding Benchmark
extraction.description: MVBench is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating temporal understanding capabilities of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in videos. It covers 20 challenging video tasks that require temporal reasoning, generated by converting static image tasks into dynamic ones. The benchmark uses multiple-choice QA pairs automatically generated from 11 public video datasets.
extraction.creator: Kunchang Li, Yali Wang, Yinan He, Yizhuo Li, Yi Wang, Yi Liu, Zun Wang, Jilan Xu, Guo Chen, Ping Luo, Limin Wang, Yu Qiao
extraction.citeAs: Li, K., Wang, Y., He, Y., Li, Y., Wang, Y., Liu, Y., Wang, Z., Xu, J., Chen, G., Luo, P., Wang, L., & Qiao, Y. (2024). MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Video Understanding Benchmark. arXiv:2311.17005v4.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is constructed by selecting videos from 11 existing public video benchmarks (STAR, PAXION, Moments in Time V1, FunQA, CLEVRER, Perception Test, Charades-STA, MoVQA, NTU RGB+D, VLN-CE, TVQA) and automatically generating multiple-choice QA pairs using ChatGPT based on task definitions and ground-truth annotations.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Videos are sourced from 11 public datasets: STAR, PAXION, Moments in Time V1, FunQA, CLEVRER, Perception Test, Charades-STA, MoVQA, NTU RGB+D, VLN-CE, TVQA.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data filtration: short clips with negligible motion and extremely long videos are removed; videos with intermediate duration (5s to 35s) are selected. For STAR, start/end points are randomly shifted to increase complexity. For CLEVRER, questions requiring more than 10 conditions are excluded. Answer options are randomly sampled (3 to 5) and shuffled; LLM ensures similar and reasonable lengths.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Multiple-choice QA pairs are automatically generated from video annotations using ChatGPT. For most tasks, option candidates are constructed from ground truth annotations (template-based). For the Unexpected Action task, ChatGPT converts open-ended QAs into multiple-choice format. Each task has 200 QA pairs.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: All models and data are publicly available at https://github.com/OpenGVLab/Ask-Anything.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The benchmark may have limitations in tasks related to position, count, and character recognition, as current MLLMs struggle with these. Also, visual information alone may not be sufficient for some cognition tasks; other modalities like depth and audio could be beneficial.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluation of temporal understanding capabilities of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in videos.
